name: Measles & vaccine-preventable
summary: US measles cases reach 5,182 in 2026, the most since 1991; Mexico has 13,761 cases and 23 deaths
state: The CDC counted 5,182 US measles cases in 2026 as of 5 Nov, up 330 in a week; states have reported eight deaths, three of them between 2 and 5 Nov in New York, Pennsylvania and Wisconsin (Contagion Live). PAHO's 6 Nov report counts 13,761 cases and 23 deaths in Mexico and 1,126 cases in Canada to 31 Oct. Large outbreaks in high-income countries meet Watch; deaths are rising in the US, but a multi-country surge with rising deaths is not yet clearly established, so the level stays Watch.
for_you: Measles spreads easily among people who are not vaccinated. The NHS and UKHSA advise checking that children and adults have had two MMR doses, especially before travel to North America.
rubric_hit: Large outbreaks in high-income countries (US 5,182 cases, Canada 1,126) meet Watch; multi-country surge with rising deaths not confirmed

sources.title: PAHO — Situation Report #15: Measles in the Americas Region
Al Jazeera — CDC reports more than 5,000 measles cases, highest number in 35 years

why: Falling vaccination rates are bringing back diseases once eliminated; measles is the canary for the rest.

rubric.alert: Multi-country surge with rising deaths, or polio/diphtheria resurgence in high-income countries.
rubric.watch: Large outbreaks in high-income countries, or loss of elimination status.
rubric.normal: No large outbreaks in high-income countries.
